description: Composition archetypes group hobbies with similar scene-construction needs so prompts stay reusable instead of one-off per hobby.

solo_action.label: Solo Dynamic Action
solo_action.composition: A single human figure captured mid-action at the peak of physical effort, dynamic pose with implied motion (motion blur, dust, spray, or fabric movement), camera angle slightly low or side-on to emphasize power and momentum, environment visible but secondary to the figure.

craft_maker.label: Craft / Maker Focus
craft_maker.composition: A person actively engaged with their hands or tools on the core object of the hobby, medium-close framing that shows both the skilled action and enough environment to read as a real studio/workspace/performance setting, warm practical lighting on the work surface.
craft_maker.emotion: concentration, mastery, quiet flow state, creative satisfaction

social_gathering.label: Social Gathering
social_gathering.composition: Multiple people (3-4) grouped closely around a shared activity/table, visible interaction (leaning in, laughing, reacting), warm ambient light source in frame (lamp, candles, string lights), activity's key objects clearly readable on the table/surface.

journey_atmosphere.label: Journey & Atmosphere
journey_atmosphere.composition: A wide-ish environmental scene with a human figure small-to-medium in frame to convey scale and sense of place, strong depth (foreground/midground/background layering), distinctive recognizable location cues, dramatic natural or golden-hour lighting.

lifestyle_ritual.label: Lifestyle Ritual
lifestyle_ritual.composition: A beautifully styled close-to-medium shot of the hobby's signature object presented with premium presentation quality, human hands or a seated figure present for lifestyle context (not just a product shot), soft warm ambient interior lighting.
lifestyle_ritual.emotion: comfort, indulgence, mindful ritual, everyday luxury

atmosphere_immersive.label: Immersive Atmosphere
atmosphere_immersive.composition: A scene built around a strong light source and a large-scale focal element that anchors the hobby, human figure(s) present but often silhouetted or backlit to preserve mood, heavy atmospheric depth (haze, glow, reflections).
